question.text: In the following system, $\mathrm{PCl}_5(\mathrm{~g}) \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{PCl}_3(\mathrm{~g})+\mathrm{Cl}_2(\mathrm{~g})$ at equilibrium, upon addition of xenon gas at constant $\mathrm{T} \& \mathrm{p}$, the concentration of

solution.text: On addition of inert gas at constant P \& T, reaction moves in the direction of greater no. of moles so it will shift in forward direction, so $\left[\mathrm{PCl}_5\right]$ decrease and $\left[\mathrm{PCl}_3\right] \&\left[\mathrm{Cl}_2\right]$ will increase.
